{{for|the chapter in ''The Eye of the World'' called "The Peddler"|The Eye of the World/Chapter 3}}
[[File:Peddler.jpg|thumb|150px|right|A male [[Taraboner]] peddler]]

'''Peddlers''' are traveling merchants, carrying news to isolated communities as much as their goods. 
Along with the [[Tinkers]] and [[Gleemen]], and for a time the [[Cairhienin]], they are the only people allowed by the [[Aiel]] to enter the [[Aiel Waste]].
